name: Meng De Da Xiaojie Yu Zibao Shaonian
original_name: 孟德大小姐与自爆少年
source: This is a modern Three Kingdoms-themed visual novel titled 'Miss Mengde and the Exploding Boy'. You will play as Guo Fengxiao, a college student with a terminal illness, who meets Cao Cao, a character who has traveled from 1800 years ago. However, this Cao Cao is not the one you learned about in history class - she has long legs, a slender waist, and a female body! How will you deal with this unexpected surprise?

However, this Cao Cao is not the one you learned about in history class - she has long legs, a slender waist, and a female body! How will you deal with this unexpected surprise?
